Title: Asset Class Trend (GTAA 5)
Rule: Hold each ETF when above its 200-day SMA; else hold T-Bills/Cash.

Title: Dual Momentum Equities (GEM)
Rule: Hold 12-month winner between SPY & EFA if return > 0%; else hold BND.

Title: Defensive Canary Allocation (DAA)
Rule: Monitor Canary assets (VWO & BND). Hold risky ETFs when Canaries are positive; shift to BND when negative.

Title: Momentum Factor in Stocks
Rule: Rank US Equity ETFs by 6-month momentum. Hold top 2 (50% each) if above 200-day SMA.

Title: Momentum Effect in Commodities
Rule: Rank Commodity ETFs by 6-month momentum. Hold top 2 when above 200-day SMA.

Title: Value & Momentum Across Assets
Rule: Combine 12-month Momentum rank + 3-year Value reversal rank. Hold top 3 above 200-day SMA.
